description: This file contains utility functions related to persisting and applying theme (light/dark) settings within an Android application. It defines an object `ThemeUtils` with methods to apply saved themes, toggle themes, retrieve the current saved theme, and save theme preferences.

classes.name: ThemeUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to manage theme preferences (light/dark) in an Android app.

methods.name: applySavedTheme
methods.description: Applies the theme that was previously saved in preferences at application startup.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches the current theme between light and dark modes, saves the new setting, and applies it.

methods.name: getSavedTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the saved theme mode ('light' or 'dark') from SharedPreferences, defaulting to 'light'.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Saves the specified theme mode ('light' or 'dark') into SharedPreferences.
